messages:
noor: Thanks for the all-hands. A few customer questions landed after the meeting around security/privacy/compliance. Short clarifying asks: SOC2/ISO timelines and what we can share publicly, VPC private control plane beta details (SSO/entitlements, cross-account routing), audit log field-level retention & how to handle prompts/embeddings for GDPR/CCPA, and BYOK/HSM rotation semantics. Can we get owners + brief answers so support/sales have something to share?

sec-bot: Uploaded compliance slide pack and a tracker: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/compliance-updates. Created an office-hours poll: https://cal.com/redwood/security-qna 

taylor: Quick summary from security: SOC2 Type II audit window target = Nov-Dec 2026; we expect controls in-place by Sept 2026. ISO 27001 assessment is scoped but target is mid-2027 (longer runway). We'll publish the control mapping and a customer evidence checklist next week.

rick: Infra/VPC note: private control plane beta moved to July (small cohort). Beta features: private endpoints, cross-account peering with IAM role trust, and SSO via SAML/OIDC (in beta). Networking checklist + required IAM/materials will be in the beta docs.

mina: Audit logs: v1 exports include these fields: ts, service, model_artifact_id, model_version, model_hash, quant_profile, request_id, route, latency_ms, token_in, token_out, actor_id. Hosted default: prompt_text is redacted/truncated in Console views and exports (90-day retention). We will add an opt-in for full-text export. Important: embeddings are treated specially 1 if a customer flags embeddings as PII, they should opt to export hashed/embed_id only. Example event (v1): ```{"ts":"2026-07-20T18:03:12Z","service":"inference","model_artifact_id":"rwd-13b-202607","model_version":"v2.2","model_hash":"f1e2d3c4","quant_profile":"q4_8bit","request_id":"req_0G7H","route":"/v1/embed","token_in":0}```

evan_support: Two customer asks: 1) can we provide a short one-pager for field sales on what hosted vs private customers can expect re: logs/PII? 2) For hosted opt-in full-text logs, what's the process for a customer to get that enabled?

mina: Answers: 1) Sales one-pager = yes, product will draft bullets today (what to say now vs later). 2) Hosted full-text logs require explicit admin consent in Console, acceptance of a data retention policy, and a signed addendum for some regulated customers; we'll surface the exact steps in the FAQ.

noor: GDPR/CCPA specific: will we support data subject deletion for prompts/embeddings if a tenant requests it (hosted)? Also, what about embeddings that are reversible or linkable?

taylor: Good question. Hosted: prompts are redacted by default so deletion surfaces are limited; for hosted full-text opt-in customers we'll support export/deletion workflows per our DSR (data subject request) process; this will be in the privacy docs. Embeddings: we recommend customers hash embeddings before storage if they contain PII. We'll annotate the SDKs with a utility to hash/embed_id and add guidance in the privacy playbook.

rick: Technical note on BYOK: Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) today. We use envelope encryption; rotating the KMS key is supported but requires a coordinated rewrap for long-lived artifacts. HSM-backed BYOK (FIPS/HSM) is on the roadmap for Q1 2027 alpha. We'll publish a rotation guide with expected steps and a runbook for cache rekeying.

evan_support: Action items I captured: 1) Product: 1-pager for sales + short FAQ for hosted vs private logging (owner: @mina); 2) Security: publish SOC2 control map + DSR guidance (owner: @taylor); 3) Infra: VPC beta networking checklist + SSO setup guide (owner: @rick); 4) Docs: BYOK rotation playbook and HSM roadmap (owner: @rick/mina). Office hours to triage remaining Qs.

sec-bot: Tasks created: [sales-1pager_logging], [soc2-controls_map], [vpc-beta-networking], [byok-rotation_playbook], [privacy-dsr-guide]. Will ping owners tomorrow at 13:00 UTC.

mina: I'll post the sales one-pager draft in #product by EOD today and the FAQ by 2026-07-01.

taylor: SOC2 controls map + DSR doc by 2026-07-08.

rick: VPC beta checklist + SSO guide by 2026-07-10. BYOK rotation playbook draft by 2026-07-15. HSM alpha plan Q1 2027.

noor: Thanks all. Please drop any follow-ups here; we'll run the detailed Qs in the office hours and circulate the final artifacts to support/sales before next week. :thumbsup:
